summary: Completed the initial schema-version-2 review of Nidec Corporation's Frankfurt ordinary shares after the 2026-07-31 bullish-MACD crossover. The signal followed a 6.16% 20-session decline and coincided with a 5.31% one-session rebound, but the small positive MACD histogram, neutral RSI and 72-share Frankfurt volume make it an unconfirmed technical rebound rather than a trade catalyst. Nidec's latest interim statements report operating strengths and positive free cash flow but warn that suspected inappropriate accounting could materially and pervasively affect the figures. The audited annual filing is delayed to September 30, 2026, and a separate external investigation is assessing group-wide quality issues and their unquantified financial impact. The deterministic assessment is Unrated/Watch, research-unsupported and allocation-ineligible, with accounting uncertainty, insufficient listing liquidity and unsupported valuation as hard blockers. No scenario values, strategy or idea follow-up were created.

evidence.claim: Nidec reported first-half fiscal 2025 net sales of JPY 1.302 trillion, operating profit of JPY 21.1 billion, operating cash flow of JPY 112.3 billion and free cash flow of JPY 45.2 billion. Automotive recorded an JPY 82.8 billion operating loss. The statements say ongoing investigations could have a material and pervasive effect, the possible impact was not reflected, the report was not subject to interim review, and full-year guidance was undetermined.

Nidec disclosed potential quality issues at multiple production sites, including unapproved changes to materials, processes and designs, testing and inspection-data handling, and origin labeling. No immediate functionality or safety impact had been identified, but customer consultations and an external investigation were ongoing and the financial impact was undetermined.

Nidec received approval to extend the filing deadline for its annual securities report covering the year ended March 31, 2026 from June 30 to September 30, 2026, leaving the audited annual financial base unavailable at this review date.
